description: Defines Determinex's top-level product shell: five surfaces (idea_lab, repo_clinic, maintenance_bay, learning_studio, proof_operator_center), one shared authority vocabulary (the 8-class vocab from CLAUDE_AUTH_005_READY_AUTHORIZED_LANGUAGE_LOCK_001), and a per-surface declaration of purpose, target_users, beginner_view, professional_view, inputs, outputs, status_states, blocked_states, proof_evidence_requirements, source_mutation_boundary, training_eligibility_boundary, and claim_caveats. build_record() refuses any model that: (1) is missing one of the five required surfaces; (2) has a surface with no visible blocked_states; (3) declares source_mutation_boundary using 'authorized by default', 'open by default', 'auto-apply', or 'no approval required'; (4) Learning Studio's boundary not 'non-mutating' or 'routes to repo_clinic/idea_lab gates'; (5) Proof Operator Center boundary not 'read-only' or 'non-authorizing'; (6) any surface's training_eligibility_boundary opens training or fails to explicitly state training stays False / does not open.
